balance_note: 1 credit = HK$1, deductible directly at checkout
empty_message: Your wallet transaction history will appear here
error_message: Your balance is unaffected. Please check your connection and try again. If the issue persists, contact us.
faq_1: Earn 1 point for every HK$1 spent, based on actual payment amount.
faq_2: Every 100 points automatically converts to HK$10 in your Space Wallet—no action needed.
faq_3: Points earned from a booking are credited after payment and cannot be used for that booking.
faq_4: Promo codes and Space Wallet credits cannot be combined.
faq_5: When you cancel a booking, any credits used will be fully refunded to your Space Wallet.
